title: Comparison inverse images of injective abelian sheaves are direct-image acyclic
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and comparison geometric morphism $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{proet}}	o X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Use its inverse image and direct image on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every injective abelian sheaf $I$ on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the abelian sheaf $
u_X^{-1}I$ is acyclic for $
u_{X,*}$, meaning $$R^q
u_{X,*}(
u_X^{-1}I)=0\qquad(q>0).$$ Here $R^q
u_{X,*}$ is computed by an injective resolution in abelian pro-etale sheaves and degree-$q$ cohomology of its direct-image complex [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. No affineness, torsion, constructibility or finite coefficient ring hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution R of nu_X^* I in A-valued pro-etale sheaves. For each q, R.isoRightDerivedObj identifies the positive comparison direct image with homology of nu_X,* R. Restrict its degree-(q+1) short complex along AffineEtale.Spec X. This restriction is faithful and exact because the affine etale site is a dense subsite. It therefore suffices to show exactness after this restriction.

For W in X.AffineEtale, let T be its pro-etale image. Its structure morphism is etale and its source affine. Etale.injective_upperStar_obj_of_etale′ sends I to an injective on T.left_et. Apply stage3-affine-comparison-injective-derived-vanishing to this injective. The canonical adjunction conjugate comparisonUpperStarUpperStarIso identifies the resulting sheaf with the pro-etale pullback of nu_X^* I. Restriction to the localization T.left_proet is exact and preserves injectives. Evaluation of that restriction at the identity of T.left is naturally evaluation at T, via Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _). Transport this natural isomorphism through rightDerived and apply Functor.rightDerivedCompIsoOfExact. The result is vanishing of positive derived evaluation at T on X_proet. This entire localization calculation is the proved private helper affine_etale_sections_vanishing.

R.isoRightDerivedObj for evaluation turns step 2 into exactness of the evaluated short complex at every affine etale object. These are definitionally the evaluations of the underlying presheaf of the restriction in step 1. ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation gives presheaf exactness. Exact sheafification preserves it; ShortComplex.mapNatIso with sheafificationNatIso identifies the sheafified complex with the restricted sheaf complex. Finally faithful exact restriction reflects exactness, so the original homology is zero for each q. No assertion identifies sections of a higher direct-image sheaf with derived sections.
